stories.title: What went wrong for Novak Djokovic at the US Open
stories.summary: On Sunday night, Novak Djokovic was upset by Mariano Navone in the first round of the US Open. What happened -- and what it means for the tournament.

stories.title: Djokovic, ill and hurting, out of US Open in shocker
stories.summary: Novak Djokovic, 39, is out of the US Open after a first-round defeat to Mariano Navone on Sunday night, losing 7-6 (5), 5-7, 4-6, 6-2, 6-1 in a marathon match that lasted 4 hours, 36 minutes. Djokovic had never lost in the first round at the US Open.

stories.title: Donald signs 1-year deal, rejoins 'complete' Rams
stories.summary: Aaron Donald, 35, a three-time Defensive Player of the Year and an eight-time first-team All-Pro, formally returned from retirement on Sunday, signing a one-year, $20 million contract with the Los Angeles Rams, a squad that he labeled "a complete team."

stories.title: Scheffler reasserts No. 1 status with 2nd Cup win
stories.summary: Scottie Scheffler held off Viktor Hovland in a back-nine duel to win his second FedEx Cup in three years.

stories.title: Venus loses after latest-ever start at US Open
stories.summary: Venus Williams bowed out of her 26th US Open singles appearance early Monday morning, falling in straight sets to fellow American wild card Sofia Kenin after not getting on the court until midnight local time.
